content.introduction: Asian markets mostly traded lower, with the Nikkei 225 falling below 69,300 and the Australian market extending losses. The Thai stock market may accelerate. The global forecast for Asian markets is mixed to higher.
body: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to the slight losses in the previous session, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Japanese stock market is trading notably lower on Tuesday, extending the slight losses in the previous session, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 falling well below the 69,300 level, with weakness in technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,615-point plateau and it may accelerate on Tuesday. The global forecast for the Asian markets is mixed to higher,... The Jakarta Composite Index now rests just above the 5,915-point plateau and it's tipped to open in the green again on Tuesday. The Taiwan stock market has moved lower in two of three trading days since the end of the three-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 2,450 points or 5.2 percent.
